title: Unbounded correction-rate policy can raise OverflowError during adoption
description: Timing correctness review: SourcePrecedencePolicy accepts arbitrarily large non-negative `max_correction_rate_ppm`; `_anchor_rejection` multiplies it through floating point. A constructible value such as 10**400 raises OverflowError on a later adoption instead of returning a controlled decision. Impose a documented safe bound or use overflow-safe integer arithmetic so every accepted policy is total. Add maximum and over-maximum tests.
